invites.title: Team invitations
invites.subtitleAdmin: Invite trainers to your organisation and keep track of every invitation.
invites.subtitlePlatform: Invite trainers and admins to your organisation and keep track of every invitation.

form.title: Invite someone
form.description: They get an email with a link that works once and expires after 7 days. Learners are not invited: they register themselves.
form.roleRequired: Choose a role for the invitation.
form.conflict: This email address already has an account or an open invitation.

resend.title: Send this invitation again?
resend.body: {{email}} gets a new email. The previous link stops working and the new one is valid for 7 days. Resends used so far: {{used}} of {{max}}.
resend.capReached: This invitation reached the resend limit. Revoke it and send a new invitation instead.

revoke.title: Revoke this invitation?
revoke.body: The link sent to {{email}} stops working immediately. You can invite the same address again afterwards.

errors.conflict: This invitation can no longer be changed because it was already accepted or revoked. The list was refreshed.
errors.notFound: This invitation no longer exists. The list was refreshed.

empty.title: No invitations yet
empty.body: Invitations you send appear here with their status.
empty.filteredBody: Try another status or clear the filter.

users.title: Users
users.subtitleAdmin: Find accounts in your organisation and suspend or reactivate learners and trainers.
users.subtitlePlatform: Find accounts in your organisation, suspend or reactivate them and change roles.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.body: {{name}} is signed out on all devices right away and cannot sign in until you reactivate the account.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.body: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.

roleDialog.title: Change the role of {{name}}
roleDialog.description: {{name}} is currently {{role}}. Choose the new role.
roleDialog.warning: {{name}} will be signed out on all devices and sees the new role after signing in again.

errors.conflict: This account changed in the meantime, or the change is not possible. The list was refreshed.
errors.notFound: This account no longer exists or is not available to you. The list was refreshed.

empty.title: No accounts to show
empty.body: Accounts appear here as people register or accept an invitation.
empty.filteredBody: Try a shorter start of the email address or other filters.
